name: unit_convert
description: Convert units: km_mi, mi_km, kg_lb, lb_kg, c_f, f_c
code:
v = float('{{value}}')
c = '{{conversion}}'.strip().lower()
import math
fns = {
 'km_mi': lambda x: x*0.621371,
 'mi_km': lambda x: x/0.621371,
 'kg_lb': lambda x: x*2.20462,
 'lb_kg': lambda x: x/2.20462,
 'c_f': lambda x: x*9/5+32,
 'f_c': lambda x: (x-32)*5/9,
}
if c not in fns:
    raise SystemExit(f'unknown conversion {c!r}; options: {sorted(fns)}')
print(f'{v} {c.split(chr(95))[0]} = {round(fns[c](v), 4)} {c.split(chr(95))[1]}')
